semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Fujibo Ehime provides precision machining abrasives essential for semiconductor device polishing.
summary: Fujibo Ehime Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing precision machining abrasives, particularly the POLYPAS Series, which are used for polishing semiconductor devices and silicon wafers. Their products are designed to meet the high-precision requirements of the electronics industry.
capabilities: POLYPAS Series abrasives for semiconductor device polishing
Precision machining abrasives for silicon wafers
Abrasives for LCD glass and optical lenses
